# Scraper de VestiaireCollective.com

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/vestiairecollective-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/vestiairecollective-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de anúncios de produtos do Vestiairecollective.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape Vestiaire Collective for Fashion Product Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-vestiairecollective)
- **Código:** [`vestiairecollective.py`](vestiairecollective.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Product pages](results/products.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Páginas de produtos da Vestiairecollective
- Páginas de busca da Vestiairecollective

## Funções

- `scrape_products(urls)` → `dict`: scrape vestiairecollective.com product pages for product data
- `scrape_search(url, max_pages=10)` → `List[Dict]`

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import vestiairecollective


async def main():
    search = await vestiairecollective.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.vestiairecollective.com/search/?q=louis+vuitton",
        max_pages=2,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos da saída de exemplo (chaves de primeiro nível do primeiro item):

- [`results/products.json`](results/products.json): `id`, `type`, `name`, `price`, `description`, `path`, `sold`, `reserved`, `inStock`, `available`, `receipt`, `consignment`, `shouldBeGone`, `likeCount`, `measurementFormatted`, `isLocal`, `dutyAndTax`, `buyerFees`, `alternateVersions`, `metadata`, `indexation`, `flags`, `brand`, `size`, `color`, `material`, `condition`, `universe`, `category`, `subcategory`, `model`, `pictures`, `warehouse`, `pricingBreakdown`, `meshLinks`, `seller`, `prohibited`, `localizedDescription`, `originalDescription`, `originalDescriptionLanguage`, … (3 mais)
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `id`, `brand`, `name`, `description`, `country`, `discount`, `colors`, `localEligible`, `directShippingEligible`, `editorPicks`, `likes`, `link`, `model`, `pictures`, `price`, `seller`, `sold`, `stock`, `shouldBeGone`, `createdAt`, `universeId`, `dutyFree`, `personalizationType`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`vestiairecollective.py`](vestiairecollective.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"US"`: país do proxy

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/vestiairecollective-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_product_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
